pages.text: After class, Julia gets out her paints. "Toby, I will paint you," she said. "Sit still."
pages.picture: girl with a paint set and paper, dragon posing

pages.text: Toby sits as still as a rock. Julia paints his white scales, his tail and his big feet.
pages.picture: the girl painting a picture of the dragon

pages.text: "It is the best painting!" said Julia. "Wait here. I will get a drink."
When she gets back, the paint pots are on the grass. There is paint on the play house, on Toby, and on her painting!
pages.picture: paint pots tipped over on the grass, paint splattered on the playhouse, on the dragon and on the painting
the girl holding up her ruined painting, upset

pages.text: Toby looks down. His tail droops. He is too sad to say a thing.
pages.picture: the dragon with drooping tail and paint on him, very sad

pages.text: Julia stamps her foot. Then she sits on the back step and sulks.
pages.picture: the girl sulking on the back doorstep, arms folded

pages.text: But Toby looks so sad. And he has pink paint on his nose.
pages.picture: the sad dragon with a blob of pink paint on his nose

pages.text: Julia grins. "Toby, you have a pink nose!" She wipes it off, and he grins back.
pages.picture: the girl wiping paint off the dragon's nose with a cloth, both smiling
